lastCompletedStory.title: Add push-undelivered event kind to the flight recorder

nextStoryContext: US-001 added ONLY the flight-recorder shape: 'push-undelivered' WorkerEventKind member + PushUndeliveredEventDetail interface ({ paneId: string; retriesExhausted: number }) + WorkerEventDetail union entry, in src/supervisor/events.ts. Nothing emits this event yet: US-002 (extract sendKeysVerified with composer-emptied verify + bounded retry) is the story that will actually produce a 'push-undelivered' verdict, and US-003 (wire the sidecar report pusher to sendKeysVerified) is the story that will call logEvent with kind:'push-undelivered' + a PushUndeliveredEventDetail on exhausted-retry. Raised src/supervisor/events.ts's file-size-budget ceiling 674->696 (staged _ref note with CAM-200/US-001 already committed). No new external lib touched.
